title: Achieving Model Fairness in Vertical Federated Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks measured algorithmic fairness in terms of Difference of Equal Opportunities (DEO) with respect to sensitive attributes like race and gender.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness in vertical federated learning concerning demographic attributes like race and gender.
